annotations.text:
Principle: conversation is the only input.
You talk fitness, diet and sleep to the coach (Telegram or web chat); the app never asks you to fill a form. The dashboard is the mirror — every number traces back to something you said, with 'via chat' receipts.
Real data where it exists (485 kcal salad, 37g, 45-min walk, 172 lb goal). Sleep, mood, steps and the weight trend are sample values showing the designed state.
